zh.title: 法國航空空中巴士A318機隊最後航線公布
zh.summary: 法國航空空中巴士A318機隊最後數月將執飛13國37條航線
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，法國航空（Air France）空中巴士 A318（Airbus A318）機隊在退役前的最後 37 條營運航線資訊已獲揭曉。這項機隊營運安排展現了該款客機在結束服役前所規畫的最後航線網路。
據報導，法國航空這批空中巴士 A318 機隊將在其退役前的最後幾個月期間，持續執行定期航班任務。該機隊的營運範圍預計將橫跨 13 個國家，並涵蓋總計 37 條航線，作為其服役生涯最後階段的運作網絡。

en.title: Air France Final Airbus A318 Network to Span 37 Routes Across 13 Countries
en.summary: Air France's Airbus A318 fleet will operate 37 routes across 13 countries in its final months.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, details regarding the final 37 routes for Air France's Airbus A318 fleet have been officially revealed. The operational details outline the planned scheduled network for the aircraft model as it enters its final remaining months of active flight service with the carrier.

Throughout these final months of scheduled flight activity, Air France's Airbus A318 fleet will travel across a total of 13 countries while serving 37 specified routes. This network plan marks the concluding operational phase for the aircraft type across its active flight network prior to retirement.
